name: Music from the Deep
jem_summary: Obtain Water Horse from a Seahorse rider or Barbaric after a Barbed kills a Creeper.

pages.title: Music from the Deep
pages.text: Obtain Water Horse from a Seahorse rider or Barbaric after a Barbed kills a Creeper.

pages.title: Music from the Deep
pages.text: A second themed disc and moonstone furnish a display for rare marine finds.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: A baby Drowned riding a Seahorse is the Water Horse route; a Barbed killing a Creeper is the Barbaric route. Choose either. Command-given discs do not count.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Defeat a baby Drowned riding a Seahorse. Native lore identifies this uncommon Music Disc Water Horse acquisition route.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Have a Barbed kill a Creeper. The native lore identifies Music Disc Barbaric as the uncommon result; Barbed attacks waterborne players with explosive barbs.
